_source: Golden conversation (docs/plans/text-advisor/11-testing-rollout.md § Engine golden conversations). Model responses are hand-written to the Messages API shape; numbers are fictional (555 series).
description: Golden 3 (TA-I1 part): the owner of a verified boat invites a deckhand by number; the tool result never echoes the number; the invitation (YES/NO and the STOP line) goes to the deckhand's number through the channel and links nothing yet; a question before answering is a normal turn whose brief says an invitation is pending; the deckhand's YES makes them crew; their next reply is a normal turn whose brief shows them as crew on the boat; the owner removes them and they are an angler again. TA-I2: before the removal, the deckhand texts a count-board photo; it becomes the boat's report (contact_id the deckhand, boat b-rita), the board stays private (no photo consent), and the deckhand's Y publishes it with verified 1 (the boat is verified).

turns.in: Add my deckhand, his number is (805) 555-0142

content.text: Done. I texted him an invitation; he joins the crew once he replies YES.

contains: Captain Dave invited you to join Rita G as crew: your count boards and catch photos would post under the boat. Reply YES to join or NO to decline. Reply STOP to opt out.

rows.sql: SELECT c.role, c.boat_id, c.source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advisor_crew) AS crew_rows FROM advisor_contacts c WHERE c.source='skipper-invite'

content.text: SkipperCast, the fishing report line. Captain Dave invited you to the Rita G crew; reply YES to join or NO to decline.
